summary: A set of toggles sharing one container, in four shapes and both orientations, pressing one or several at a time.

props.name: label
props.description: A caption above the group, wired to it as its accessible name.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Stacks the toggles and switches the arrow keys that move focus.

props.name: multiple
props.description: More than one toggle can be pressed at a time. Off by default, matching Base UI, so a group is single-choice unless you say otherwise.

props.name: value
props.description: The pressed toggles, controlled. Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The pressed toggles on first render, uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the pressed values whenever they change.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the container. The toggles inside carry their own `shape`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignores interaction on every toggle in the group.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged with the group's own classes, so a utility you pass wins.
